identity.title: C04 Ordinary experience from three months ago, never a Memory

remainingRisks: Deterministic mode: replies are a fixed stub sentence. Nothing here is evidence about what a real model would say.

Deterministic mode: the Decision itself (whether to look history up, the search clues, the people and the continuation basis) comes from the fixture script, not from a model. A passing objective criterion proves the pipeline and source control for that Decision; it does not prove that a model would choose it.

Pipeline-only: `O-commit`, `O-history`, `O-old-source` were judged on a step whose scripted Decision used hindsight clues (not literally in the current message or the person's previous seven days of messages). Their verdicts are not evidence of selection quality, and the case is not shown as a complete pass.
This is a development fixture. Final validation needs separately authored fixtures frozen before tuning.
Timings are CLI network observations, not browser rendering times (T08 #321 covers the browser).
